requirements.missing: No mention of Cucurbita maxima, C. moschata, or any oilseed-pumpkin market class; no distinction between cleaned/dried shelled seed and whole winter fruit.

Mentions purity analysis, germination, tetrazolium, moisture content and seed count only as generic AOSA options for unspecified crops; gives no specific assay conditions (days, temperature, substrate), no crop-specific germination test protocol, and no certified thresholds for oilseed pumpkin.

No quantitative thresholds for germination percentage, seed purity, moisture content or contaminant limits are provided for oilseed-pumpkin seed; document lacks acceptable-vs-unacceptable ranges, source geography and date relevant to this crop.
